title: Validate a Binary Search Tree: Checking the Mail Routing Desks
summary: Every desk inherits a range from the desks above it; the first number outside its range fails the whole chart.

analogy.scenario: A mailroom routes letters through desks: at each desk, lower unit numbers go left and higher ones go right. A desk only works if its number fits every turn a letter took to reach it.

mapping.real: A routing desk and its unit number
Lower numbers go left, higher go right
The range of numbers that can reach a desk
Desks still waiting for a verdict
Stopping at the first misrouted desk

takeaway.pattern: Depth-first search with bounds passed down
takeaway.summary: Pass a (low, high) range to every node. Going left, the node's value becomes the new upper bound; going right, the new lower bound. A value outside its range fails, and && stops the search there.
whenToUse: Checking an ordering rule that involves every ancestor, not just the parent
Any tree check where constraints narrow on the way down

scenes.narration: A mailroom routes letters through desks. At each desk, lower unit numbers go left and higher ones go right. Is this routing chart correct?
scenes.caption: Lower unit numbers go left, higher numbers go right

scenes.narration: Comparing each desk with the desk right above it misses mistakes further up, and comparing it with every desk above it repeats work at each level.
scenes.caption: Checking each desk against its parent isn't enough

scenes.narration: Instead, hand each desk the range of numbers that can reach it. Desk 10 is first, so anything goes, from minus infinity to infinity.
scenes.caption: Desk 10 has no limits yet

scenes.narration: Letters reach desk 5 by turning left at 10, so desk 5 must be below 10. It is. Its own right side must now stay between 5 and 10.
scenes.caption: Left of desk 10, every number must be below 10

scenes.narration: Desk 3 fits. Then desk 12: it's bigger than 5, so its parent looks happy, but it sits left of 10. A 12 could never be routed there.
scenes.caption: Desk 12 must be between 5 and 10, but it's above 10

scenes.narration: False travels back up, and desk 10 stops right away. Desk 15 is never checked: one misrouted desk is enough.
scenes.caption: One misrouted desk fails the chart: 15 is never checked

scenes.narration: Desks are nodes, and each call carries a low and high bound that tighten on the way down. Each node is checked once: O(n) time, O(h) space.
scenes.caption: Desks are nodes; the range is (low, high)
